raw: Agent Name: Planner, Step Number: 13, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified Gaston’s paternal grandmother by moving one generation too far up the paternal line—naming Antoine de Bourbon’s mother (Françoise d’Alençon, Gaston’s great-grandmother) instead of Henry IV’s mother, Jeanne d’Albret, who is the correct paternal grandmother.
